himalayanmonal: A Himalayan monal cock standing in side view, a stocky pheasant with METALLIC IRIDESCENT plumage: a shimmering emerald-green head, a coppery-red and violet nape, a deep blue-green back, a CLEAN WHITE PATCH ON THE LOWER BACK and a SHORT SQUARE RUST-ORANGE TAIL. From its crown rises a SMALL NARROW TUFT OF ABOUT TWENTY FINE BARE WIRE-LIKE SHAFTS each tipped with a tiny flat spatula, standing no taller than its own head. Bare turquoise skin rings the eye. Absolutely NOT a peacock: no fanned train and no eye-spots.
electriceel: An electric eel held HORIZONTAL IN LEVEL SIDE PROFILE, and it is A FISH AND NOT A SNAKE. Its body is a long thick rounded cylinder of even depth, with a BROAD BLUNT ROUNDED HEAD no narrower than the neck, a wide flat mouth and small eyes set well forward. A SINGLE VERY LONG RIPPLING FIN RUNS THE WHOLE LENGTH OF ITS UNDERSIDE from throat to tail tip. Slate grey-brown above, ORANGE-YELLOW across the throat and chin. Its head is not raised and its body is not looped.
giantclam: A giant clam seen at a three-quarter angle so the shell reads as one solid heavy object. Its two thick chalky-white halves gape apart along a DEEPLY ZIGZAGGED WAVY LIP like interlocking teeth, the outside ribbed with several broad radiating flutes. Swelling out between the open halves is a THICK SOFT FLESHY MANTLE, rippled and folded like heavy velvet, coloured electric blue-green and gold and speckled with fine iridescent dots.
chinstrappenguin: A chinstrap penguin standing upright, a medium penguin with a bright white face, cheeks and throat and a neat black cap over the crown. THE BLACK LINE RUNS SIDEWAYS ACROSS THE UNDERSIDE OF ITS CHIN FROM ONE EAR TO THE OTHER, passing beneath the beak like the strap of a helmet - a fine band crossing the throat HORIZONTALLY, never a stripe running down the front of the neck. Black back and flippers, white front, small black bill, pink feet.
colossalsquid: A colossal squid, a massive heavy squid with a SHORT WIDE MUSCULAR REDDISH MANTLE, blunter and deeper than other squid, and two broad triangular fins at the rear. ITS EYES ARE THE LARGEST OF ANY ANIMAL: each is a huge dark globe bulging from the side of its head, far too big for its face, ringed with a pale rim. Its eight thick powerful arms and two longer tentacles carry ROWS OF SHARP CURVED SWIVELLING HOOKS as well as suckers.
ivorygull: An ivory gull standing, a compact gull whose ENTIRE PLUMAGE IS UNBROKEN PURE SNOW WHITE - head, neck, back, wings, wingtips, tail and belly ALL EXACTLY THE SAME WHITE, with no grey across the back or wings and no dark tips anywhere. The only dark parts of the whole bird are its SHORT BLACK LEGS, its black feet and its large black eye. Its bill is short and stout, blue-grey at the base fading to yellow at the tip.
rossgull: A Ross's gull, a SMALL DELICATE gull with a slim body, long pointed wings and a WEDGE-SHAPED TAIL coming to a point in the middle. Its back and upper wings are PALE PEARL-GREY, its head white, and its underparts carry a SOFT ROSE-PINK BLUSH - a faint wash of colour spread over the breast, not a solid pink patch. A NARROW FINE BLACK LINE encircles its neck like a thread. Its bill is very small and black, its short legs bright red.
americancurl: An American curl cat sitting in three-quarter view, a medium silky-coated cat, and ITS EARS ARE THE POINT AND MUST BE UNMISTAKABLE: each ear BENDS BACKWARD IN A SMOOTH FIRM ARC so that the tip sweeps back and downward toward the nape of the neck, the opening facing forward and upward, curving over like a rolled petal. They do NOT stand upright and are NOT pointed. Long tufts of pale fur spill from each ear opening. Walnut-shaped eyes, a plumed tail.
cornishrex: A Cornish rex cat standing in side view, a slender fine-boned cat with an arched back and long thin legs. IT IS FULLY COATED AND NOT BARE: a SHORT DENSE PLUSH COAT COVERS ITS ENTIRE BODY and lies in CLOSE REGULAR WAVES like corrugated ripples running across the back, flanks and tail, soft and clearly textured. Its whiskers are short and crinkled. Very large upright ears set high, a narrow egg-shaped head, prominent cheekbones.
